description: Divisional Secretariat - Manthai East - Vannivilankulam Sri Muththumari Amman Temple Annual Festival - 2023 Mullaitivu District
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the dates and regulations for a specific religious festival (Vannivilankulam Sri Muththumari Amman Temple Annual Festival). The content involves public notification of cultural/religious event scheduling and references to existing regulations, but does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (Types 4-9). As it concerns cultural/religious administrative matters not covered by other types, it falls under Miscellaneous (Type 10).
